{{Quote|The Sith were thought dead more than once, but they always come back.|Mikki's father|<ref name="JvS 1">[[Jedi vs. Sith 1|''Jedi vs. Sith'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''father''' of [[Mikki]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Near the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], he had three sons. The four were [[Scavenger/Legends|salvagers]] on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. While scavenging, one of his son's found Mandalorian armor. When the other son commented that the Sith Lord's were gone, the man told his children that the Sith had been thought extinct multiple times yet they always came back.

His youngest son Mikki found [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] [[Darth Bane's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The man told Mikki to throw it away. Suddenly, the lightsaber [[Telekinesis/Legends|rose]] into the air and ignited, beheading the eldest son. Darth Bane rose from the rubble and telekinetically slew the other son. The father held Mikki close and pleaded with Bane to spare Mikki. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Mikki, fueling himself on the father's pain to survive his [[Synox/Legends|synox]] [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] by [[Githany]] before killing him as well.
